hook: Decorrelation stretch reveals invisible ancient paintings
what_happened: A Singaporean archaeologist applied NASA’s decorrelation stretch to Angkor Wat photos, uncovering about 200 faded paintings.
why_it_matters: It removes the bottleneck of faded rock art visibility, enabling study of lost cultural heritage.
the_catch: Most of the roughly 200 paintings are probably later graffiti left by pilgrims, not planned temple murals.
caption: A NASA imaging technique revealed about 200 faded paintings inside Angkor Wat, most of them probably graffiti left by later pilgrims.
alt_text: A five-slide carousel explaining how decorrelation stretch enhancement of flash photographs revealed about 200 faded paintings inside Angkor Wat, and why most are probably later graffiti.

es.hook: El estiramiento de decorrelación revela pinturas antiguas invisibles
es.what_happened: Un arqueólogo de Singapur aplicó el estiramiento de decorrelación de la NASA a fotos de Angkor Wat, descubriendo unas 200 pinturas descoloridas.
es.why_it_matters: Elimina la limitación de la visibilidad del arte rupestre descolorido, permitiendo estudiar el patrimonio cultural perdido.
es.the_catch: La mayoría de las aproximadamente 200 pinturas son probablemente grafitis posteriores dejados por peregrinos, no murales planificados del templo.
